name: Angel Reason ~Tenshi no Iiwake~
original_name: エンジェリーズン ～天使のいいわけ～
source:
School life is over in a few months. With parents gone overseas it's a great opportunity to make memories with the school's idol. 
Wizards, ghosts, robots and rabbits coexist at this school. Something must happen in such a perfect environment! 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
再过几个月，校园生活就要结束了。父母去了海外，正是与校园偶像一起留下回忆的好机会。
魔法师、幽灵、机器人和兔子在这所学校共同生活。如此完美的环境，一定会发生些什么！

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]］
